stem.text: Heart surgery may cause a decrease in the transmission of impulses in the Purkyne tissue to the right side of the heart.
What is a possible effect of this decrease?

A.text: Impulses would be delayed by the atrioventricular node.

B.text: The muscle of the right ventricle would contract slightly more slowly than the muscle of the left ventricle.

C.text: The muscle of the right atrium would not contract as fully as the muscle of the left atrium.

D.text: The sinoatrial node would transmit fewer impulses.
